component.name: Text
component.description: Polymorphic text component with size, line height, and terminal font variants.

semanticRole.container: p (default) | span | div | strong | em | cite | h1 | h2 | h3 | h4 | h5 | h6

behavior.map: Polymorphic text component. Renders as different HTML elements via 'as' prop (p, span, div, strong, em, cite, h1-h6). Size variants (XXS-XXL). Line height variants (tight-loose).
behavior.rendering: Always renders text with configured element, size, and lineHeight.

nesting: Can be nested based on 'as' prop (e.g., p cannot contain p).

accessibility.keyboard: Non-interactive (unless 'as' prop is heading for skip links).
accessibility.contrast: Inherits color (ensure parent provides sufficient contrast).

responsiveness.rules: Text wraps based on container width.

usageNotes: Polymorphic via 'as' prop (p, span, div, strong, em, cite, h1-h6).
Size variants: XXS, XS, S, M (default), L, XL, XXL.
Line height variants: tight, snug, normal, relaxed, loose.
Supports all HTML attributes via rest props.
Color inherited from parent (no color prop).
Use Title component for semantic headings.
Use for body text, captions, labels.
